resources.string: On the iPhone, open Settings → Bluetooth. Choose your iPhone from the list and confirm the pairing on both devices.
Scan finished. If the iPhone is missing, keep its Bluetooth settings open and scan again.
Could not scan or pair. Try again or open the car Bluetooth settings.
Confirm the pairing request on the car and iPhone.
Assign an unused key. The wheel-key service brings an active CarPlay session forward; during calls the car keeps its keys. Availability depends on the car.
That key is reserved for the car, calls or media. Choose another key.
For the selected iPhone, try to play if music was playing before disconnection. Pausing on the phone while away may not be detected.
